mutations.name: a new choice does not replace the old
mutations.old: ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, provider, model) DO UPDATE SET minutes = excluded.minutes, changed_at = excluded.changed_at
mutations.new: ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, provider, model) DO NOTHING

mutations.name: unknown workspace listed as empty
mutations.old:
if (!q.workspace.get(workspaceId)) throw new StoreError('not-found', `no workspace ${JSON.stringify(workspaceId)}`);
    return q.answerWaits

mutations.name: waits of every workspace listed
mutations.old: SELECT * FROM answer_waits WHERE workspace_id = ? ORDER BY provider, model
mutations.new: SELECT * FROM answer_waits WHERE workspace_id = ? OR 1 ORDER BY provider, model

mutations.name: schema allows a wait of 0
mutations.cmd: pnpm -s exec vitest run packages/store/test/migrations.test.ts -t "positive wait"
